title: Bundled Hire Everyone
doc: Supplies the verified Hire Everyone SQL and locale payload to the native mod loader. Independent of ModelRules. Disable the separate Hire Everyone Workshop item before using this slice.
uiDoc: Enables the bundled starting roster and Underworld Hub recruits. Start a new campaign to use the starting roster.

fields.label: Enable Bundled Hire Everyone
fields.doc: BundledRebalances.Init verifies the installed payload and AfterList supplies it to the native mod list.
fields.uiDoc: Disable the separate Hire Everyone Workshop mod before enabling this switch.
